## About

I am a researcher working on autonomous robotics, with a focus on control, exploration, and perception for unmanned aerial vehicles. My work spans model-predictive control, information-driven planning, and extended reality frameworks for testing robotic systems.

## Research Areas

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6}
### Control
Nonlinear and sampling-based controllers for UAVs — MPPI, NMPC, geometric, and sliding-mode approaches with GPU-accelerated backends.

[View projects &rarr;](projects/index.qmd#control)
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### Mapping
Information-theoretic exploration using Shannon mutual information on volumetric maps with efficient run-length encoding.

[View projects &rarr;](projects/index.qmd#mapping)
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### Planning
Next-best-view planners integrating information-gain metrics into ROS 2 navigation stacks.

[View projects &rarr;](projects/index.qmd#planning)
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### Other
Extended reality frameworks for robot testing, fusing real-world motion with synthetic visual data.

[View projects &rarr;](projects/index.qmd#other)
:::

:::
